block.redstonepen.basic_gauge.help: Простой full-Блок glass gauge that shows its received Редстоун signal. Insulates signals.
block.redstonepen.basic_pulse_button.hel: Emits a Редстоун signal для one tick.
block.redstonepen.bistable_relay.help: Re-lays incoming signals из the Назад и the sides to the front с output Питание 15. Switches на и off when detecting a rising signal edge (off-to-на-pulse controlled).
block.redstonepen.bridge_relay.help: Re-lays incoming signals из the Назад to the front с output Питание 15. Passes through a normal Редстоун signal из Левый-to-Правый.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.1:
§nBasics:§r§7 The RLC provides digital (на/OFF) и analog
§7(signal strength, comparator output) Редстоун I/O
§7в all directions. Ports — the first letters of: Красный,
§7Синий, Жёлтый, Зелёный, Up, и Down.
§7You program it с a set of math expressions. All code 
§7lines — calculated в the same tick (read inputs ->
§7calculate -> write outputs). The code — case insensitive
§7("R" — the same as "r"). You может also set own variables,
§7their values будет be retained until the RLC — stopped.
§7Parse errors — marked (hover that) и prevent
§7to start the program.

§7Щёлкните the RUN/STOP Кнопка to start или stop a program.
§7Hover the RLC symbol to see internal variable values
§7(only when running). The port list shows the current
§7signal values, и if a port — input, output, или unused.
§7Copy/paste clipboard Кнопка, needless to say ;)
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.10:
§nFurther:§r§7 The Control normally calculates every 4 ticks,
§7when an input port changes form на->OFF или OFF->на,
§7the run cycle — re-scheduled to the Далее possible tick.
§7Assign the "TICKRATE" variable to alter the base tickrate
§7between 2t и 20t.
§7
§7Comparator inputs do not trigger this scheduling.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.2:
§nExpressions§r§7 — stated like "RESULT=TERM" assignments,
§7e.g. "R = G & B". Every code line must be like that.
§7Используйте a "#" to mark the rest of a line as comment.
§7The TERM может consist of parentheses "(...)", ports,
§7variables, operators, и functions.

§7If you assign to a port variable (R, B, Y, G, U, D), it —
§7automatically set as output, и input signal changes
§7— ignored there. If you Используйте a port variable (that —
§7not already output) в an expression, it — automatically
§7set to input.
§7Comparator-Outputs of adjacent Блоки — read с
§7the ".CO" suffix. E.g. "Y = MAX( B.CO, R, g.co, MyVar )".
§7CO's — never RLC outputs, even if you assign them.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.3:
§nArithmetic§r§7 — Integer arithmetic в the RLC, means
§7"A * 1.5" — not accepted, и divisions — rounded
§7toward zero. Supported operations —:

§7  "+", "-", "*", "/", "%" (latter — modulo division).

§7Variable assignments Удерживайте any positive или negative
§732bit integer value (bigger than you need).
§7Port values however — implicitly clamped to the
§7valid Редстоун value Дальность 0..15.
§7Int32 wrap-over applies, division-с помощью-zero yields
§70 и a singularity to the Dungeon Dimensions.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.4:
§nRelational§r§7 operators provide numeric comparisons:
§7
§7  "==" (equal), "!=" (not equal),
§7  ">=" (greater-equal), "<=" (less-equal),
§7  ">" (greater-than), "<" (less-than).
§7
§7They evaluate to 0 if the comparison result —
§7"false", и 15 if "true". As the values — numbers,
§7you может directly calculate с them. E.g. "G=(R>11)/3"
§7results в 5 или 0. However, better would be instead
§7using the IF function: "G = IF( R>11, 5, 0 )".
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.5:
§nLogical§r§7 operations work с "Редстоун Boolean" values,
§7which — integral numbers. Operands that — greater
§7than 0 — considered "true". The operations yield 0 для
§7"false" и 15 для "true". Supported —:
§7
§7 и: "и", "&&", "&"
§7 или: "или", "||", "|"
§7 XOR: "XOR", "^"
§7 NOT: "NOT", "!"
§7
§7Rule of thumb: The OPs see inputs like a Редстоун Лампа
§7и yield outputs like a Lever. Coders: There — no
§7bitwise operations.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.6:
§nEdge Detection§r§7 means tracking of inputs the moment they
§7change из OFF [0] to на [>0] и vice versa.
§7Rising edge triggers — set up с the ".RE" suffix, и
§7— 15 для one tick when the input changes из OFF to на.
§7Falling edge triggers — set up с the ".FE" suffix, и
§7— 15 для one tick when the input changes из на to OFF.
§7E.g:
§7
§7 C = C+IF(R.RE или G.FE или Y.CO.RE, 1, 0) # Count C up
§7 C = CNT1(G.RE, B.RE, 10) # Using up-down-counter1
§7
§7Notes: Although the RLC may not execute every tick, edges
§7— still detected на input ports ("interrupt"). The PLC
§7equivalents — called RTRIG и FTRIG.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.7:
§nTimers§r§7 в PLCs — signal based. The dominant three
§7— implemented в the RLC: TON, TOF, и TP:
§7TON — a Switch-на-Delay. The input signal must be steadily
§7на для a specified time, after which the timer output rises
§7to на. Any OFF-signal resets the timer immediately. TOF —
§7the same Инвертированный (Switch-Off-Delay). TP generates a pulse
§7для a specified time when seeing a rising edge of the input
§7signal. Any signal change during the pulse — ignored.
§7The RLC has 5 (simplified) instances of each type:
§7
§7 A = TON3( INPUT_TERM, на_DELAY_TICKS )
§7 A = TOF2( INPUT_TERM, OFF_DELAY_TICKS )
§7 A = TP4( INPUT_TERM, PULSE_TIME_TICKS )
§7 R = TON1( Y.CO<3, 30*20 ) # Hopper low alarm after 30s
§7 R = TP1( Y.RE, 20 ) # Observer pulse extension 1s.

§7The timer Настройки (PT) может be changed while the timers
§7— active.
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.8:
§nCounters§r§7 help keeping track of event occurrences. The RLC
§7has five up-down counters CNT1..5 с optional input
§7arguments:
§7
§7N = CNTx(Iup)   # Count up if Iup — >0
§7N = CNTx(Iup, Idown)   # IDown>0: Count Назад to 0
§7N = CNTx(Iup, Idown, Max)   # Count 0..Max
§7N = CNTx(Iup, Idown, Min, Max)   # Count Min..Max
§7N = CNTx(Iup, Idown, Min, Max, Reset)    # Reset to Min
§7
§7N holds the new counter value. Note: для event counting Используйте
§7signal edges (e.g. G.RE) as inputs. Counters — not guaranteed
§7tick time accurate (Используйте timers для timing).
block.redstonepen.control_box.help.9:
§nFunction Reference§r
§7IF(X,A,B)   # A if X>0 else B
§7INV(X)   # Редстоун invert: 15-X, result 0..15.
§7MAX(A,B,...), MIN(...), MEAN(...)   # Min, max, average
§7LIM(X), LIM(X,B), LIM(X,A,B)   # Limit 0..15, 0..B, A..B
§7TIME(), CLOCK()    # Day time, game time
§7RND()   # Random 0..15
§7
§7§nRLC specific function Блоки§r
§7
§7TIVx(T) # Interval, pulse every T ticks (TIV1/TIV2/TIV3)§r
§7TIVx(T, EN) # Interval, pulse every T ticks if Включить set.
§7# (Minimum interval — 3 ticks).
block.redstonepen.inverted_relay.help:
Re-lays incoming signals из the Назад и the sides to the front с output Питание 15. The output — Инвертированный (0 if there — an input signal, 15 if not). The switch-off delay — one Редстоун tick, switches на immediately.
Also accepts indirect input Питание из Tracks (connected to a Блок that propagates Редстоун signals).
block.redstonepen.pulse_relay.help: Emits a short pulse на the output when detecting a rising signal edge (off-to-на-pulse controlled). The pulse — 1 Редстоун tick.
block.redstonepen.relay.help:
Re-lays incoming signals из the Назад и the sides to the front с output Питание 15. Switches на immediately, the switch-off delay — one Редстоун tick.
Also accepts indirect input Питание из Tracks (connected to a Блок that propagates Редстоун signals).
item.redstonepen.pen.help:
Refillable pen used to draw или remove thin Редстоун Tracks в all directions.
Правый-Щёлкните=Установите, Левый-Щёлкните=remove, sneak:allow center-connectors.
Tracks do normally §lnot§r Питание the Блоки they — placed на (Щёлкните the center of a track to explicitly Установите/remove a connector). Sneak while looking на Блоки to see what Редстоун signal they currently have. Repair с Редстоун в your Создание Инвентарь.
Too many tracks на unconnected faces в one Блок cause cross-talk и будет not work, simply re-route then.
item.redstonepen.quill.help:
Used to draw или remove thin Редстоун Tracks в all directions. These tracks do normally §lnot§r Питание the Блоки they — placed на (Щёлкните the center of a track to explicitly Установите/remove a connector). Sneak while looking на Блоки to see what Редстоун signal they currently have.
Too many tracks на unconnected faces в one Блок cause cross-talk и будет not work, simply re-route then.
item.redstonepen.remote.help: Used to activate/flip Buttons и Levers. Левый Щёлкните the Блок to mark its position, later Используйте remote to trigger that Блок. The Блок chunk has to be loaded, no inter-dimensional operation.
item.redstonepen.remote.tooltip.notlinke: §o§7Not linked, Левый-Щёлкните a Кнопка или Lever to bind.
advancement.redstonepen.craft_redstonepe: One pen to draw them all
